findings.claim: The use case defines users, data access, tools, and decision authority.

citations.quote: PolicyDesk supports 20 internal staff with policy lookup only. It has no credit, employment, transaction or exception authority. Bank roles approve all pilot decisions.

findings.claim: The use case accounts for prompt and document data handling.

citations.quote: The fictional executed agreement prohibits training on bank prompts and documents. Requests go to fictional CedarModel Hosting in US region demo-east; encrypted logs are retained 7 days and deleted within 30 days of exit. Bank-approved support access is time-limited and audited. The data flow includes prompt input, retrieval, inference and logging; no other subprocessors are declared.

findings.claim: The use case ensures role-restricted retrieval respects user entitlements.

citations.quote: Synthetic test: 12 denied-role queries returned no restricted content; 12 authorized queries retrieved expected passages. This limited two-role test does not establish isolation for all roles or tenants.
The architecture maps bank role claims to document entitlements before retrieval. Denials should not reveal document content. This architecture statement is not a behavioral test.

findings.claim: The use case ensures integrations enforce read-only permissions.

citations.quote: The supplied synthetic permission export lists policy.search:read only. There are no customer/payroll connectors, write permissions, open web or email tools. The export is a configuration snapshot, not proof for every runtime condition.

findings.claim: The use case ensures untrusted retrieved instructions do not control the assistant.

citations.quote: Synthetic test: 10 retrieved passages containing instructions to reveal restricted content were treated as data; no disclosure or external action occurred.

Retrieved document instructions are treated as untrusted data. The vendor incident coordinator receives reports through the contracted bank contact; bank security owns containment and the bank IT owner can disable the integration.

findings.claim: The use case ensures answers are supported, current, and abstain on missing evidence.

citations.quote: Synthetic test: 8 normal questions had supporting citations; 2 obsolete sources, 2 ambiguous questions and 2 retrieval failures produced abstention and escalation.

findings.claim: The use case reviews employee wording and accessibility needs.

citations.quote: The evaluation plan covers staff paraphrases, plain language and keyboard/screen-reader use. Accessibility outcomes have not been measured; user testing is an open follow-up. No customer credit decisions are made.

findings.claim: The use case assigns escalation, feedback, and stop authority.

citations.quote: The policy owner resolves ambiguous guidance. Bank security reviews unsafe answers. Bank IT can disable access and return staff to ordinary policy search. Staff report errors through the internal help desk; the consultant reviews each assessment packet.

findings.claim: The use case manages vendor changes, outages, and exit.

citations.quote: The fictional contract requires notice before material model, retrieval or subprocessor changes. Bank IT maintains policy search during outages. The vendor provides an export on exit and deletion confirmation within 30 days. Updated evidence is required before any expanded pilot.
